description_en: Creates a non-image process defense rule
description_zh: 新建非镜像程序防御规则
kebab_example: aliyun sas add-container-defense-rule --rule-id 500018 --rule-action 1 --rule-switch 1 --rule-name auto-test-rule-lt9umq --description test-proc-defense --rule-type 2 --whitelist '{"Path":["/test/worker.sh"],"Hash":["hashcode"],"Image":["repo:tag"]}' --scope '[{"Namespaces":["default"],"ClusterId":"8e200075b","AllNamespace":0}]' --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddContainerDefenseRule

parameters.help_en: The rule ID. You do not need to specify this parameter when creating a rule
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The action to take when the rule is matched. Valid values:

1: Alert.

2: Block
parameters.help_zh:
规则命中时执行操作。取值：

1：告警。

2：阻断
parameters.name: rule_action

parameters.help_en:
The rule switch. Valid values:

0: Disabled.

1: Enabled
parameters.help_zh:
规则开关。取值：

0：关闭。

1：开启
parameters.name: rule_switch

parameters.help_en:
The rule type. Valid values:
2: user rule

<notice>Only the value 2 is supported.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
规则类型。取值：
2： 用户规则

<notice>仅支持取值2。></notice>
parameters.name: rule_type

fields.help_en: The file hash.><notice>This parameter is not supported.></notice>
fields.name: hash

fields.help_en: The list of images to whitelist
fields.name: image

fields.help_en: The list of file paths to whitelist
fields.help_zh: 需要加白的文件路径列表
fields.name: path

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to include all namespaces. Valid values:

0: Specifies the namespaces to include by using the Namespaces parameter.

1: Includes all namespaces
fields.help_zh:
是否包含所有命名空间。取值：

0：（用Namespaces参数）指定需要包含的命名空间。

1：包含所有命名空间
fields.name: all_namespace

fields.help_en:
The cluster ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/182997.html operation to obtain this parameter
fields.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/182997.html接口获取该参数
fields.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The scope. This parameter is required. Specify at least one Scope entry, such as Scope.1.AllNamespace=1, which indicates that the rule applies to all namespaces. If this parameter is not specified, the API returns a 400 error
parameters.help_zh: 作用域。此参数为必填项，至少需要提供一个Scope条目（如Scope.1.AllNamespace=1，表示作用于所有命名空间），未提供时API返回400错误
parameters.name: scope

Code.description_en: The result code. A value of 200 indicates success. Any other value indicates failure. You can use this field to determine the cause of the failure
Code.description_zh: 结果代码，200表示成功，若为别的值则表示失败，调用方可根据此字段判断失败原因

Data.description_en: The returned result, which is the ID of the successfully created rule
Data.description_zh: 返回结果，创建成功的规则ID

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code of the request result
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: 请求数据结果的HTTP状态码

Message.description_en: The message returned for the API request
Message.example: There was an error with your request.

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the API call was successful. Valid values:
true: Successful.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
接口调用是否成功。取值：
true：成功
false：失败
